description: Comparison-analysis config: cross-attribute statistics for the evaluator. 'grounded_joint_pairs' entries are {pair:[x,y], grounded:bool, basis:str}; grounded=true means the real population's joint over the pair comes from a real SCB API conditional cross-tabulation (per docs/scb_population_distribution_analysis.md), grounded=false means the reference joint is itself a marginal product / forced-independence copy. 'combination_checks' generalise the coherence triple to configurable {attributes, k, threshold} sets. 'c2st' tunes the classifier two-sample test.

grounded_joint_pairs.basis: age_sex (audit §1, 'NO DIFFERENCE'): SCB query separates Kon; parser preserves the (age_group, biological_sex) joint.
civil_status (audit §8, 'NO DIFFERENCE'): sampled conditional on (age_group, biological_sex); parser preserves both dimensions.
civil_status (audit §8, 'NO DIFFERENCE'): sampled conditional on (age_group, biological_sex).
income_source (audit §13, 'NO DIFFERENCE'): sampled conditional on (employment_status, age_group); parser preserves both dimensions.
income_source (audit §13, 'NO DIFFERENCE'): sampled conditional on (employment_status, age_group).
education_by_age (audit §2, 'conditioning lost'): education conditional on age_group but sex pooled; field is not API-identical.
employment_by_age (audit §3): sex pooled and education ignored; field is not API-identical.
employment_by_age (audit §3): parser assigns identical employment distribution across all education levels -> forced independence, not a real conditional joint.
